_comment: Data manifest. Every source the app loads is listed here with a pinned commit, the exact files used, its license and the attribution the app must show. Edit this file to add or bump a source, then run `python -m sic_pipeline lock` to refresh file hashes.

sources.name: Berean Standard Bible
sources.license: Public domain (dedicated by Berean Bible / Bible Hub, April 30, 2023)
sources.attribution: The Holy Bible, Berean Standard Bible, BSB. Produced in cooperation with Bible Hub, Discovery Bible, OpenBible.info, and the Berean Bible Translation Committee. Dedicated to the public domain.
sources.notes: Fetched from the scrollmapper/bible_databases mirror (OSIS JSON with word-level Strong's alignment) because it can be pinned to a git commit. The official downloads at bereanbible.com are the upstream source; the mirror's README labels the text CC0.

sources.name: STEPBible Data (Tyndale House, Cambridge)
files: Translators Amalgamated OT+NT/TAHOT Gen-Deu - Translators Amalgamated Hebrew OT - STEPBible.org CC BY.txt
Translators Amalgamated OT+NT/TAHOT Jos-Est - Translators Amalgamated Hebrew OT - STEPBible.org CC BY.txt
Translators Amalgamated OT+NT/TAHOT Job-Sng - Translators Amalgamated Hebrew OT - STEPBible.org CC BY.txt
Translators Amalgamated OT+NT/TAHOT Isa-Mal - Translators Amalgamated Hebrew OT - STEPBible.org CC BY.txt
Translators Amalgamated OT+NT/TAGNT Mat-Jhn - Translators Amalgamated Greek NT - STEPBible.org CC-BY.txt
Translators Amalgamated OT+NT/TAGNT Act-Rev - Translators Amalgamated Greek NT - STEPBible.org CC-BY.txt
Lexicons/TBESH - Translators Brief lexicon of Extended Strongs for Hebrew - STEPBible.org CC BY.txt
Lexicons/TBESG - Translators Brief lexicon of Extended Strongs for Greek - STEPBible.org CC BY.txt
Proper Nouns/TIPNR - Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References - STEPBible.org CC BY.txt
sources.attribution: Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge (CC BY 4.0). Source: https://STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data
sources.notes: STEPBible asks users to note any changes they make to the data. Changes made by this pipeline are listed in data-pipeline/CHANGES-TO-SOURCE-DATA.md. TIPNR descriptions (@Briefest, @Brief, @Short, @Article and the #Summary field) are described in the STEPBible README as created by Claude 3 AI and are NOT imported (sourcing rule 1).

sources.name: Theographic Bible Metadata
sources.attribution: Theographic Bible Metadata by Robert Rouse (viz.bible), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Includes Easton's Bible Dictionary (1897, public domain text).
sources.notes: Event and verse dates follow one chronology (Ussher-style, e.g. creation at 4003 BC). The app must label them 'per Theographic' (sourcing rule 4). Theographic's own KJV verse text is not imported.
